Summary

The pure Python parser is vulnerable to an HTTP request smuggling attack.

### Impact

If users are using the Python parser (`AIOHTTP_NO_EXTENSIONS`, or not a standard wheel installed), then an application may be vulnerable to a request smuggling attack.

### Workaround

Switch to the default C parser.
